newsitem.title: FINLAND: HONKARAKENNE SEES '97 EARNINGS UP ON '96.
newsitem.headline: HONKARAKENNE SEES '97 EARNINGS UP ON '96.

text.p: Finnish logwood house maker Honkarakenne Oy said on Thursday it expected full-year 1997 earnings to improve on 1996.
"The result for the year is expected to be clearly improved from the previous year," Honkarakenne said in a statement with its January-April results.

"The result trend for the fall season and the last quarter will be overshadowed by the drastic increase in prices of sawn products, although the good performance of the first quarter will improve the annual results compared to the previous year," it said.
The market prefabricated logwood houses was expected to grow to 900 million markka and Honkarakenne said its market share was 33 percent.
"Growth is sought in Germany and from sales of single-family homes," it said.

"The increased order book indicates a positive trend of net sales and profitability for the rest of the year. The share of exports of total orders will improve the level of profit margins," Honkarakenne added.
